definition.threshold: explicit P1/P2, or distinct sub-majors > 2, or roles > 50 with at least two distinct sub-majors; P3 stays flat except the independently resolved D022 case
definition.priority3_override: P3 excludes clustering; D022 conflict with P1 is recorded, not silently resolved
definition.role_demand_ordering: deferred until a validated role-demand dataset exists

promotion_impact.domain_count: Promoting a subgroup creates a new top-level domain and increases the domain count; it is not a display-only rename.
promotion_impact.ccmas_programme_mapping: Every promotion requires a fresh CCMAS programme-to-domain mapping pass because programme links, match tiers, and downstream domain references may change.
promotion_impact.proof_gate: Do not promote from subgroup size or intuition alone; require an independent source-backed domain definition, distinct foundation evidence, role boundary, and reviewed programme impact.

definition_conflicts.detail: The specification lists D022 as both Priority 1 needing clustering and Priority 3 excluded because engineer/technician is a level split.

independent_resolution.reason: The four groups represent materially different work directions: management, engineering/geology, technical surveying/safety, and drilling/mining operations.

threshold_design.reason: The current OR threshold requests a subgroup card even when all roles share one ISCO sub-major; that produces one card and does not reduce directional clutter.
threshold_design.recommendation: Use more than two sub-majors, or more than 50 roles with at least two sub-majors, as the clustering trigger; keep a single-sub-major domain flat and demand-sorted.

source_layer.detail: domain_skill_provenance currently repeats domain foundation skills inside subgroup skill maps.

runtime.detail: No role-demand dataset is available yet; roles must not be ordered by an unavailable demand metric. Preserve source/insertion order until a validated demand table is introduced.
